supporting_observations.claim: Repeated svc-grades failures occurred from FILE-ORC-01, reported at 10.56.20.20, at roughly one-minute intervals from 13:32 through 13:47 UTC; the failures report an incorrect password (SubStatus/Status 0xc000006a).

The failure pattern is consistent with the inventory and change calendar: svc-grades is a FILE-ORC-01 job that re-authenticates every minute, and its password was scheduled to rotate at 13:30 UTC, shortly before the failures began.
The available records show failed authentication attempts, but do not establish that any of these attempts succeeded.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy log collection was unavailable from 13:25 to 14:10 UTC, overlapping the review window; proxy activity during that interval cannot be verified from the stated telemetry status.
claims_not_established: The records do not identify which application or service initiated each failed authentication; the logged process is LSASS, not the client job executable.
The records do not establish whether or when the GradeSync job was updated with the rotated password.
The explicit-credential event does not establish whether authentication to the proxy succeeded or whether it was related to the repeated failures.
additional_evidence_needed: For the alert, verify the svc-grades rotation and GradeSync update timestamps against FILE-ORC-01 job or service logs.
Separately, review restored or retained proxy logs and validate the OpsAgent executable and its credential use.
unrelated_findings: At 13:30 UTC, FILE-ORC-01 recorded an explicit-credential event using svc-grades to target PROXY-ORC-01 from C:\Program Files\Meridian\OpsAgent\ops-agent.exe. This software is not listed among the approved software in the provided inventory; investigate in a separate ticket. The event alone does not show whether proxy authentication succeeded. (T282-00001)
